name: holding-for-aki-and-held-statin
text:
Age: 74
Sex: Male
Hospital day 2.
Home meds:
  lisinopril 20 mg daily - HOLDING for AKI, resume when Cr < 1.5
  atorvastatin 40 mg nightly - HELD during admission (transaminitis)
  metoprolol succinate 50 mg daily - HOLDING for bradycardia
Cr 2.1 (baseline 1.1)
note: Every antihypertensive and the statin are on hold during an admission - ambiguous for a chronic-risk tool, so both flags stay blank ('holding' must be treated like 'held'). 'Cr < 1.5' is a resumption target and 2.1 is an AKI value, so eGFR must not be computed from either.
